satiety.description: The saturation restored by the food

eatenStack.description: When an instance of this collectible is eaten, what item stack should be returned to the player? Possible example: Eating a 'meat on a stick' item would return a single stick. (Note: Bowl meals/liquids are specially designed to do this through their attributes and class.

health.description: The health restored by the food. Usually actually used to hurt the player with negative values.

intoxication.description: How much eating this will affect the player's intoxication. (0..1)

psychedelic.description: How much eating this will affect the player's psychedelic perception. (0.1)

saturationLossDelay.description: The delay before that extra saturation starts to go away.
